seo_description: Net Impact IU is Kelley's sustainable business club. 90+ IU students do free consulting for Bloomington nonprofits, volunteer, and prep for impact careers.
headline: Net Impact at Indiana University: Kelley's Sustainable Business Club
intro: Net Impact Indiana University is the undergraduate Net Impact chapter at the Kelley School of Business in Bloomington, Indiana. It's a student-led club for IU students, from any major, who want to use business as a force for good. Members do free consulting for local nonprofits, volunteer in the Bloomington community, and build skills for careers in sustainability and social impact.
hero_image_alt: Net Impact IU members in professional attire outside on the Indiana University campus, Fall 2026

pillars.title: Nonprofit consulting project teams
pillars.text: Each semester, teams of one project lead and five student consultants take on a real project for a local nonprofit, from marketing and fundraising to research and data analysis.

pillars.title: Professional development for impact careers
pillars.text: Weekly general meetings with hands-on workshops help members explore careers in sustainability, corporate responsibility and social impact.

pillars.title: Service and community
pillars.text: Members volunteer together at organizations like Hoosier Hills Food Bank and build friendships through socials and campus events.

nonprofit_text: Net Impact IU offers free, semester-long consulting to Bloomington-area nonprofits. A team of six IU students meets with your organization weekly or biweekly, sends regular progress updates, and delivers finished work by the end of the semester.
